name: Fire Ore
description:
Ore found in Raktehelm Volcano's lava flows.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the power of fire due to the lava's intense heat.
"I went discovered this miraculous ore when I was surveying Agnara Volcano. The primordial power emanating from this ore was incomparable to any other ore I had encountered before."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 1
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Firelight" BGN - INT - ADV
(Tuesday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials"  BGN - INT - ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Water Ore
description:
Ore found in Raktehelm Snowdrift Mountain.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the coldness of snow.
"As I continued my research, I found this ore, which holds trace amounts of magical energy. It shares the same properties as the other ores I have been researching."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 2
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Font" BGN - INT - ADV
(Wednesday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Earth Ore
description:
Ore found in the limestone cave in Raktehelm's forest.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the strength of the forest.
"These unique ores must have absorbed magic from the surrounding area. Changes can be seen not only in the colour of the ore, but in its ability to influence things of the same element."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 3
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials In The Leaves " BGN - INT - ADV
(Thursday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Light Ore
description:
Ore found in Raktehelm's Ruins.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the power of Light due to being bathed in it in the ruins.
"With the discovery of this Light Ore, I have determined two ways these ores come to possess elemental power. One way is to be exposed to powerful elemental power, and the other is to be exposed to the same elemental power over a long period of time."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 4
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Sunbeams" BGN - INT - ADV
(Friday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV 
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Dark Ore
description:
Ore found in Raktehelm's Magic Cave.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the power of dark, due to lying in the darkness for a long time.
"Further research has made it possible to use the power hidden in these ores without breaking them. This will allow us to create new items which couldn't be made before.
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 5
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Darkness" BGN - INT - ADV 
(Monday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV 
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Fire Crystal
description:
Crystals found in the caverns of Raktehelm's Volcano.
Fire Crystals are supposedly created when Fire Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"This crystal amazed me. We already have the technology to create crystals artificially, but these natural crystals hold far greater power than our artificial ones. Human ingenuity still lags far behind the forces of nature."
Archam Waiver, from "Crystals To Adore" Chapter 1
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Firelight" BGN - INT - ADV
(Tuesday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Water Crystal
description:
Crystals found in Raktehelm Snowdrift Mountain.
Water Crystals are supposedly created when Water Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"I have realized that with these crystals, we can make even more powerful items than before. Soldiers and people from magic organizations from other countries have started visiting me..."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 2
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Font" BGN - INT - ADV
(Wednesday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Earth Crystal
description:
Crystals found in the limestone cave in Raktehelm's forest
Earth Crystals are supposedly created when Earth Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"The military has begun funding my research, and although thanks to their funding, I have been able to create higher quality crystals, I have started having doubts about what I'm doing."
Archam Waiver, from "Crystals To Adore" Chapter 3
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Leaves" BGN - INT - ADV
(Thursday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV
 (Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Light Crystal
description:
Crystals found in Raktehelm's Ruins.
Light Crystals are supposedly created when Light Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"I could not allow my research to be used for slaughter any longer. I secretly prepared a way to escape from the military. My humanity is more important to me than my research."
Archam Waiver, from "Crystals To Adore" Chapter 4
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Sunbeams" BGN - INT - ADV
(Friday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Dark Crystal
description:
Crystals found in Raktehelm's Magic Cave.
Dark Crystals are supposedly created when Dark Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"I took my research and escaped after making this discovery. It wasn't easy, but I'll won't mention any details in this book, since doing so may inconvenience the people who helped me."
Archam Waiver, from "Crystals To Adore" Chapter 5
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Darkness" BGN - INT - ADV
(Monday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" BGN - INT - ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Volcano Spirit Stone
description:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of raging fire.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over this volcano. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"I escaped from my country and asked a temple to shelter me. They didn't pressure me to make weapons for them, and I came to trust them."
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 1
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Firelight" ADV
(Tuesday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Glacier Spirit Stone
description:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of extreme cold.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over this glacier. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"Doing my research under the protection of the temple has had unexpected benefits. I was given the opportunity to touch the immensely powerful Spirit Stone the temple keeps locked away as a divine miracle."
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 2
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Font" ADV
(Wednesday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Great Oak Spirit Stone
description:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of steadfast trees.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over the depths of nature. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"I have deduced that the Spirit Stones are made from highly purified crystals of their own element. Each stone constantly emits a remarkably large amount of energy, which has given me some new ideas."
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 3
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Leaves" ADV
(Thursday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Brilliance Spirit Stone
description:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of light.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over these ruins. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"I petitioned the temple to let me study their Spirit Stone, and they accepted. The results of my research were very promising, and I have decided to spread the word, so the whole world can benefit.
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 4
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Sunbeams" ADV
(Friday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Shadow Spirit Stone
description:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of darkness.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over these ruins. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"Unfortunately, its power will be used by the military in the end. As sickness comes to claim me, I have only one wish. I hope my research will benefit everyone somehow."
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 5
drop_information:
Exploring "Materials Hidden In The Darkness" ADV
(Monday Material Quests)
Exploring "Mysterious Materials" ADV
(Saturday, Sunday Material Quests)

name: Thick Hide
description: Hide from Moo beasts which have extremely thick skin. Because of its toughness, Moo hide is used to make a wide range of high quality, durable products, from bags and pouches to boots, gloves and armour. Moos have been successfully domesticated. Most are bred in Raktehelm's South Bamint farmlands.
drop_information:
Dropped by Giant and Dragon Bosses.
East Famelle's Fourth Tower, Demonseal Tower of Reamer.

name: Old Wand
description: This wand was created towards the end of the great war, with wood from the old oak forest in what is now Northwest La Riiz. The old oak forest was destroyed during the war, making it impossible to create any new wands. The wood the wand is made from is sturdy and has a strong affinity for magical and supernatural energies, which makes it a great base for creating magical items. Due to its rarity and many uses, however, thieves, archaeologists and weapons merchants are all fighting for it.
drop_information:
Dropped by God and Demon Bosses.
East Famelle's Moguro Beach (Flaming Fist)

name: Monster Fang
description: A fang taken from a monster. It holds great magical power and can be used as a medium for spells. If it bites into an enemy, it won't let go, so it also has its uses for Capture magic and items. These properties are useful not only for mages, but also for knights. There is a recent trend, where people send a fang to a lover to "grab hold of their heart", and many knights have rushed to defeat monsters to get one.
drop_information:
Dropped by Monster Bosses.
On the road of Gramenia Republic's Dara Desert.

name: Gem
description: A material used for making magical items. It is a liquid originally, but solidifies when mixed with a catalyst. In its solid state, it causes the effects of substances it is mixed with to diffuse into their surroundings, and can even be used to create an antidotal mist against poisons. Due to its versatility, people call daily for new compounds of the gem to be made, but so far no one has succeeded.
drop_information:
Dropped by Human and Spirit Bosses.
West Famelle's Royal Library of Lagan. "Beyond the Tide of Knowledge"

name: Plate
description: The most widely-sold metal in Raktehelm is Miram Steel. Isliid has the most abundant deposits of the metal in Raktehelm. It is easily processed, relatively resilient and very easy to come by, so it is used for everything from weapons and armour, to building materials and cooking utensils. However, although it is strong against physical attacks, it has zero magical resistance, so one must bear that in mind when using it as armour.
drop_information:
Dropped by Machine Bosses.
Can be found in West Famelle's Third Tower, Demonseal Tower of Silkira.

name: White Knight Star Stone
description: This stone was supposedly taken from the Sea of Stars. Its name is "White Knight", Guardian of the South, Governor of the Dawn. According to the Spirits' legends, aeons ago, a knight bearing the Star Stone rescued the Sun God from the Underworld, and brought light back to the world. The Spirits recite this legend whenever there is an eclipse. A Star Stone was recently discovered in the shrine of some corrupted Spirits, and a historical study of the stones has been started.
drop_information:
Sub Story "Awakening Power" Rayas' Resolve
(Sub Quest)

name: Divine Crystal of Flames
description: A rare crystal which can only be found in a handful of places in Raktehelm. The crystal appears to contain the essence of flames, and is also known as "The Everlasting Flame". This mysterious crystal has the ability to raise its own heat in response to the strength of its user's fighting spirit. Even the most skilled technicians have trouble handling it, so there are only a few weapons in the world which use this crystal.
drop_information:
Otherworld "Pride of the Warrior" Explosive Warrior, Ganan.
[EX1~EX3]
(Invasion Event)

name: Althena's Copper
description: An arcane metal rarely found in Raktehelm. It is filled with the power of Light, and shines incandescently. It is often used as a material for weapons, and has a beauty that rivals that of gold. Because of this, in the past, it caused massive inflation in market prices, and selling the metal is now forbidden without a permit. The Guild still keeps a close eye on the material and few are willing to cross them.
drop_information:
Sub Story "Awakening Power"
Wandering Around The Plains ~ Rayas' Resolve
(Sub Quest)

name: Lindrum Seed
description: This rare seed is said to bring good fortune to its bearer. The flower only grows at high altitudes and because of their rarity, they fetch a high price. A man looking for this seed eventually found a flower blooming in a Light Bird's nest. Overjoyed, he reached in to grab it, but in the same instant, he lost his footing. The man fell a great distance, but was miraculously unharmed. He was deeply disappointed, however, because the Lindrum seed he had only just obtained had used up all of its luck to save him.
drop_information:
Sub Story "Awakening Power"
Wandering Around The Plains ~ Rayas' Resolve
(Sub Quest)

name: Heliolite of Exploration
description: From ancient times, this guiding stone is said to lead a chosen one. The light of this stone opens up the bearer's soul to awaken its true power. The stone that appeared before Liese when he started his adventure in this mysterious world, was Heliolite, which embodies "Exploration". Along with a will, which shines like the Sun, Liese forges ahead with his adventure into the unknown. His discoveries may soon make all of our history books redundant.
drop_information:
Sub Story "Awakening Power"
Wandering Around The Plains ~ Liese's Resolve
(Sub Quest) Mission Reward

name: Pure Moonstones
description: This guiding stone possesses the ability to draw out the power hidden deep within a person. Over the course of her travels with her friends, this girl, who carries a unique burden has started to gain the will to live as an individual. The hidden power of this stone responds to her innocent and pure desire to protect her loved ones, and the light the Moonstone emits will cultivate limitless potential within her, and become a light to guide her along the right path.
drop_information:
Sub Story "Feelings I Want To Share"
A Restless Morning ~ I Want To Know
(Sub Quest) Mission Reward

name: Pride of Almadin
description: This guiding stone is a catalyst, which draws out the power of humans' strength of will. Almadin responds to the "Pride" of those who bear this stone, and helps them to realize their true potential. Ganan's pride, which was hurt after long years of being bound by his regret for his past mistakes was restored to its former youthful state, and the stone regained its light. Just as warriors of the past surpassed their own limits with this stone, Ganan's legend is sure to continue as well.
drop_information:
Exploring "Pride of the Warrior" Explosive Warrior, Ganan.
[EX1~EX3]
(Invasion Event)

name: Azurite of Liberation
description: This guiding stone releases the emotions buried deep within a person. In the past, a former female knight, who, fearful of her failings, bound herself in self control, became a receptionist in the arena. However, out of respect for her father, who was also a knight, and through her own encounters with adventurers, she came to realize that she could never cast her pride aside. When she saw herself for who she truly was, and chose release over suppression, she found her true strength.

name: Garnet of Desire
description: This guiding stone has the ability to change human emotions into power. A female chef once found hope in an adventurer who looked very much like her father, a man who was her mentor, and her ideal man. In order to guide the man with his promising future and to take him to higher heights, she hung this stone about her neck. The power of this stone will, no doubt, make you stronger and stronger, and allow you to reach the pinnacle of cooking and gathering ingredients.
drop_information:
Exploring "The Chef's Test" [EX1 ~ EX SP]
(Invasion Event)

name: Gem of Interment
description: This crystal was supposedly made by the Reaper himself, in order to create his own family. Anyone who holds this sinisterly glowing crystal is tormented by the Reaper's voice and their soul will eventually be dominated by him. During the great war, the demon who stole this crystal from a lesser Reaper was driven insane and began slaughtering people indiscriminately. Eventually, the demon was hunted down by his own kind for his deeds, and was buried together with the crystal. This particular crystal has never existed in the world since then.
drop_information:
Exploring "Temple Of Interment" PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Gem of Divinity
description: Created by The Divine Princess, Ladoakune, who has borne and raised many children, this crystal brings children into their own power. Although it has great magical power, it is also surrounded by the miasma of the Underworld, so it can be harmful to the children of Raktehelm. Before the great war, the land this crystal was seen in was said to be overcome by corruption, and eventually consumed by death. This crystal is indeed dangerous, but there are apparently many people who seek it for its power.
drop_information:
Exploring "Sanctuary of the Divine Princess" PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Crimson Flame Crystal
description: Occasionally found in Raktehelm, this crystal contains magical power. It is said that the changes are due to the magic stone being bathed in the power of fire for a long time. In the Isliid Empire, where there are many blacksmiths, being able to work this material is proof that you are ready to become independent. Thus, an apprentice whose ability has been acknowledged forges this magic stone into a sword in front of his teacher. This is called The Inheritance Ceremony Of Fire, a rite that has been passed down by blacksmiths since ancient times.
drop_information:
Exploring "Champion of Crimson" ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)
Exploring "Flame God's Trial" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Azure Water Crystal
description: A crystal overflowing with the power of water. Quenching with this material leaves a beautiful pattern on the blade, but it is also incredibly difficult to use. Because even the slightest change in temperature can be enough to cause it to break, the blacksmith must be knowledgeable about alchemy and magic to make a prototype. Because of this, when the crystal was first discovered, many blacksmiths became apprentices to alchemists and mages.
drop_information:
Exploring "The Cry of Shangyang" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)
Exploring "Battle against the Silent Holy Knight" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Amber Crystal
description: Amber that is occasionally found in Raktehelm. While this material is used as a processing material, it sometimes also has academic value. Although rare, there have been cases of ancient plants and animals found encased in Amber. These specimens give us clues about the ecosystem thousands of years ago. But to the blacksmith, such things are irrelevant, so they quickly get crushed beneath his hammer. The screams of archaeologists are quite audible in the smithing town.
drop_information:
Exploring "Nature's Counterattack" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Yellow Thunder Crystal
description: A rare crystal that holds the power of light. It has the ability to gather and release the elements in the atmosphere. During the great war, the Magus Empire of La Riiz tested this crystal's possible military applications, and prototypes were eventually sent to the battlefield. It is said that the crystals bursting with magical power were released and the enemy burned, but all of the Magus Empire's frontline soldiers were killed, too. Since then, the magic research laboratory has kept one Yellow Thunder Crystal to remind them of their folly.
drop_information:
Exploring "Fortress of the Machine Gods" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)
Exploring "Glowing Sanctuary" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Black Rites Crystal
description: A jet-black crystal occasionally found in Raktehelm. It can enhance the properties of a material when used during weapon processing. In the past, a blacksmith used the crystal with some scrap metal, and made a sword with a jet-black blade. It was just for fun really, but surprisingly, a number of people absolutely loved it. Afterwards, there were apparently a large number of self-proclaimed "pitch black swordsmen enthralled by the darkness".
drop_information:
Exploring "Cave Of The Abyss" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)
Exploring "Temple Of Interment" ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Magic Stone of Fire
description:
A Magic Stone inscribed with an ancient rune.
It contains the power of fire, and is thought to have been created by the Gods. Even a slight bump or application of heat can cause the stone to ignite, so care must be taken when carrying it. It has been a useful enhancement material since ancient times, but because of its temperament, fires are not uncommon. Because of this, in the Isliid Empire, it is now customary to have an alchemist's atelier in the workshop that handle Magic Stones.
drop_information:
Exploring "Champion of Crimson" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)
Exploring "Flame God's Trial" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Magic Stone of Water
description: A Magic Stone thought to have been created by the Gods. Ancient runes are inscribed on the stone. It contains the power of ice. Because it constantly emanates cold air, it can be used not only as a material for processing armour, but also as a coolant. This rare Magic Stone is apparently set out in the town square Gramenia Republic to cool the populace. While the people of the Republic are quite pleased by this, some criticise it, saying it's just a political performance.
drop_information:
Exploring "The Cry Of Shangyang" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)
Exploring "Serenity's Sword" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Magic Stone of Earth
description: A Magic Stone found in Raktehelm. Ancient runes meaning "Earth" are inscribed on the stone. It contains the power of Earth. It is currently used as a material for processing weapons, but its origins are still unknown. An adventurer discovered the stone deep within the decayed Ancient Forest of Gonal in a shrine to the Spirits. Because of this, we know that the Magic Stone was created before the era preceding the great war.
drop_information:
Exploring "Nature's Counterattack" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Magic Stone of Light
description: A Magical Stone that was created in ancient times. A rune meaning "Sky" is inscribed on the stone. It contains the power of light. Because it is constantly charged by the elements, it is dangerous to touch it with your bare hands. In the past, some on the Beast tribes used these stones for hunting by throwing them into rivers and simply taking the fish that floated to the surface. Now, however, it seems their pride dictates that they hunt using their own strength.
drop_information:
Exploring "Fortress of the Machine Gods" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)(Giant Boss)
Exploring "Glowing Sanctuary" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Magic Stone of Dark
description: A rune meaning "Night" is inscribed on this Magic Stone. It contains the power of dark, but this alone would give it no abilities. However, rumour has it that its mysterious beauty drives people insane. In fact, there is a story of an empress, who enthralled by the stone, went insane and began a reign of terror. Even an expert blacksmith will refuse to handle this Magic Stone after sunset.
drop_information:
Exploring "Cave Of The Abyss" INT - ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Gem of Scarlet Flame
description: A crystal said to be expelled from the divine Fire Dragon Deglumagna's mouth when it roars. Since the dragon only emerges once every few hundred years, there are very few of these rare crystals. Additionally, Petra, one of Isliid's greatest adventurers writes: "The bearer of this gem will gain mighty power, but that power will also bring him great ruin."
drop_information:
Exploring "Champion of Crimson" PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Gem of Brilliance
description: This crystal is also called "Brilliant Dragon, Fos Radius". Because it glows so brightly, all other gems look dull in comparison, it is highly sought after by adventurers and thieves. However, it is said that anyone touching this gem will cause the Light Dragon to rain down destruction on the world. The dragon has been enraged for many years after the crystal's theft, but the truth of the matter is somewhat different. The crystal, in fact, controls a seal the dragon put on itself because it abhors its own destructive power.
drop_information:
Exploring "Glowing Sanctuary" ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Gem of Obedience
description: Every so often, there are individuals within the Valzandes who are blessed with exceptional latent ability and extraordinary loyalty. It is said that they will crystalize themselves, so they can continue to help their master even after death. These crystals are known to the Demons as "Valzandes' Will", and recently discovered records show that they were stored carefully by their masters. This proves that trust and respect exist even among the Demons, but whether that trust and respect can be directed at humans is another matter entirely.
drop_information:
Exploring "Cave Of The Abyss" ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Ice Wolf's Divine Crystal
description: A rare crystal that has only been found in a handful of places in Raktehelm. It contains the soul of an Ice Wolf, a species which only inhabits lands that are absolute zero. It is said that if a person with a hesitant heart touches it, they'll be frozen in an instant. Mining for this crystal is a deadly exercise. The crystal responds only to the weapon of a user who trains tirelessly, and has a pure soul. Its hidden power, capable of guiding its user to higher heights is restricted to the chosen few.
drop_information:
Exploring "Pursuit Is A Phantom Friend"
Duel With A Silver Wolf [EX1 ~ EX SP]
(Massive Event)

name: Sacred Light Crystal
description: A crystal that was discovered in multiple areas of Raktehelm at the same time. It is very valuable, because the time and location for mining this crystal cannot be determined. It emits a divine light, but the source of its glow has not been uncovered yet. Because the crystal's glow strengthens when it is close to relics said to be from another world, researchers think that this crystal could also be from another world.
drop_information:
Sub Story "Crossed Hearts"
Dangerous request ~ Someone To Protect And Someone To Be Protected
(Sub Quest)

name: Gem of Tera
description: A crystal which is formed inside the body of the Earth Dragon, Elpuneumas, a dragon which presides over fertility. It contains the power of life, and is said to prolong the life of its owner. The powerful magical power of this dragon may bring about death and destruction, but it also brings about life and rebirth, two sides of the same coin, if you will. It stands to reason that if you can truly control this great power, you can even overcome death.
drop_information:
Exploring "Nature's Counterattack" ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Crimson Glow Crystal
description: This rare crystal can only be found in certain parts of Raktehelm. It is thought to be the crystalized power of birth - or Mother Nature. Also known as "Maiden's Passion", it shines brightly when a woman holds it. This light is said to grant power to items that have been used lovingly by a woman's hand. A battlefield for women, then... It has the greatest effect on housework, in other words.
drop_information:
Exploring "The Chef's Test"
Seeds Of Confusion [EX1 ~ EX SP]
(Invasion Event)

name: Gem of Annihilation
description: A mineral that seals the power of the Specified Facility Defence Mechanism "CODE XTF", Intruder Elimination Special Model "ERASURE". This defence mechanism was created by magic, and the emotionless, merciless - one might even say, "cruel", exacting standards of the Machines. Misusing this power permits the creation of items that have "cruel" abilities, which cannot be attained by using other materials. Whether that's a good thing for the world or not, is another matter entirely.
drop_information:
Exploring "Fortress of the Machine Gods" ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Gem of Shangyang
description: A crystal containing the power of Shangyang "Freidar". This monstrous bird is said to be the guardian of the Ice Temple. It has power over ice and snow, and according to legend, can cause a snow storm with the beating of its wings. This magic crystal steals the warmth of its surroundings just be being present, and since it is difficult for an adventurer to bring back to a safe place, this valuable material is kept within collectors' circles.
drop_information:
Exploring "The Cry Of Shangyang" ADV - PRO
(Giant Boss)

name: Luxury's Divine Crystal
description: A crystal said to be discovered once every few decades in the Principality of Bamint's rose gardens. The rose's nectar is apparently refined by the Earth's divine protection. Since ancient times, this crystal has often been found by people of noble birth. It is said that the crystal chooses who may find it. In addition, its owners have often been beautiful people, with intense personalities, and the crystal shines brightest with them. Perhaps that is why so many of its owners are female knights.
drop_information:
Exploring "As A Noblewoman" [EX1 ~ EX SP]
(Massive Event)

name: Flame General's Jewel
description: Flame God, Ifrit left behind. An enormous amount of heat is contained within the jewel. It is possible to gently warm thousands of people if you can draw on its power effectively, but also possible to raze a country to the ground if you lose control, although it is said that the bearer would be incinerated before that happened. What reason could the Flame God possibly have had for appearing in the world and leaving this jewel here? name: Hot Egg
description: These creatures possess an unknown heat source within them, and merging one with a fire hero soul can improve its abilities. They're a sought-after prize for any adventurer seeking mighty hero souls, but actually getting your hands on one is extremely difficult. Besides their inherent rarity, they're far more aggressive than their appearance would suggest, and will self-destruct as a defense mechanism, taking its surroundings with it... Or so the rumors say, anyway.

name: Hot Chicken
description: The heat within a Hot Egg provided plenty of nutrition for it to grow into a Hot Chicken, and because the heat source has grown with it, it can provide even more growth when absorbed by a fire hero soul. Hot Chickens create hot gusts of wind with a slight flapping of their wings, making them even harder to catch. Some rumors even say they can breathe fire! Emphasis on the rumor part, of course. They're super cozy to hold.

name: King Hot Chicken
description: The heat source of a fully grown Hot Chicken is hot and compact enough to be compared to a furnace core. Their massive bodies always seem like they're about to blow, and you might get singed just trying to get in range: not an easy bird to catch. Hero souls that fuse with one can produce enough heat to warm an entire country, and a single King Hot Chicken is said to be worth as much as a 10,000 man army division.

name: Aqua Egg
description: A squishy lifeform filled with transparent, water-like fluid. Merging one with a water hero soul can improve its abilities via contact with the super pure fluids produced within. They're a must for adventurers seeking flexible hero souls, but good luck finding some. Due to their amphibious nature makes them hard to find, and if they sense danger, they'll quickly make themselves in a rubber ball-like shape in order to bounce far, far away.

name: Aqua Chicken
description: What's surprising about the Aqua Egg is that, despite being so squishy, it nonetheless takes the shape of a bird following incubation, and even gains the ability to fly. As it grows, the amount of fluid produced within its body increases, which should result in an even greater power boost for any water hero soul it merges with. They're even harder to catch now that they can fly, however. And adventurers love their unique squishiness, too!

name: King Aqua Chicken
description:
When an Aqua Chicken fills with pure fluid, it puffs up and expands to a size inconceivable for a mollusk: getting hit by one would probably shatter
every bone in your body. That it doesn't split apart despite its size makes it a natural wonder. A water hero soul that absorbs one of these gains incredible power, as if its entire body was suffused with holy water. Some even think it hails from some kind of long lost paradise...

name: Leaf Egg
description: Though it looks like a lone egg, this is actually an elusive plant lifeform that takes the form of a seed covering. Filled with the robust nutrients of the earth, any forest hero soul that absorbs one will gain a considerable power boost. A must-have for any adventurer seeking healing hero souls, but actually finding them is quite difficult. They possess an instinctual desire NOT to be caught, and flee from sight as soon as someone draws near, you see.

name: Leaf Chicken
description: Though various biologists have spent years theorizing on the subject, none can conclusively say what came first: the chicken or the seed. They've absorbed a tremendous amount of energy from the soil in order to grow, but that energy hasn't been lost. Far from it! In fact, a forest hero soul that merges with one will get a significant boost to its healing powers. Plus, being able to catch one as it flies about of its own volition would make a fine tale for the guild!

name: King Leaf Chicken
description: A King Leaf Chicken has become one with nature, and continues receiving earth's bounty to grow without limit. To catch one requires the dedication to catch not just a mere creature, but the entire forest itself. A forest hero soul that merges with one attains natural energies as boundless and expansive as the land itself. Stories tell of a tribe that once saw the King Leaf Chicken as a god, and worshipped it accordingly. Hardly surprising, considering the powers it holds...

name: Light Egg
description: An electric lifeform said to have come to earth alongside lightning itself. Though alive, it possess a power generator inside that amplifies the energy of any light hero soul it merges with. Adventurers in pursuit of radiant hero souls need them, but actually acquiring Light Eggs is tricky - and dangerous. Even if you can find their lightning-prone hiding spots, approaching carelessly will get you shocked instantly, or cooked to a crisp if you accidentally hurt the Egg's feelings.

name: Light Chicken
description: When the power generated inside a Light Egg exceeds a certain amount, it sheds its shell to take the form of a chicken. Light Chickens can zip through the sky to absorb electricity, storing up shocking amounts of energy. If a light hero soul absorbs one, it can gain an explosive amount of energy. You'll need to prepare yourself physically and emotionally to deal with lightning strikes from the sky if you want to get your hands on one. While wearing rubber gloves, of course.

name: King Light Chicken
description: The amount of electricity necessary to birth a King Light Chicken is said to be enough to power an entire country. They're practically like little electric power plants, and any adventurer trying to capture one does so with their life on the line. A light hero soul that merges with one will gain energy that feels a little like a series of explosions are going off inside you. In a good way. Historians theorize these creatures hold the key to explaining ancient Machine power sources.

name: Metal Egg
description: A rare, metallic lifeform that accumulates large amounts of knowledge within its shell. A hero soul that merges with it gains its knowledge as experience, making them sought-after targets for adventurers. However, there is much that is not known about its ecology and behavior, making their capture extremely difficult. Because of this, areas where Metal Eggs are spotted frequently become adventurer shanty towns overnight.

name: Metal Chicken
description: A Metal Egg that accumulates even more knowledge grows into a Metal Chicken. Hero souls that merge with them gain an incalculable amount of experience. They're far faster than Eggs, meaning that even if you manage to spot one, actually capturing it is another question entirely. After the struggle of capturing a Metal Chicken, many adventurers find themselves emotionally attached and unable to let them go.

name: King Metal Chicken
description: Gaze upon the Metal Chicken's perfected form. It has absorbed all the world's knowledge, and attained tremendous size as a result. You may think its metallic body would be lumbering and slow, but it can still fly, making it just as hard to catch as before. A hero soul that merges with a King Metal Chicken gains power equal to decades of training. An adventurer only needs one chicken to become a king themselves.
effect_text: Can be used to raise a unit's EXP.

name: Kilmon
description: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Spirits tend to be proficient in magic and healing, and are rarely seen specializing in armed combat. Among this rare breed, the Kilmon is rarer still, and is brave enough to be tasked with leading  advance strike teams. Its appearance belies incredible charging power that has sent many an enemy flying. A hero soul that obtains its power will see its attacks made sharper and more powerful as well.

name: King Kilmon
description: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Those Kilmons that attain noteworthy proficiency in combat receive a king's crown as proof. They serve as leaders for other Kilmons, and are tasked with seeing strike operations through to success. Having a king overseeing an attack-focused operation fills a Kilmon with a sense of gratitude. A hero soul that receives a Kilmon King's power will reach an even deeper understanding of combat.

name: Kilmon God
description: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. After achieving significant experience and battlefield accomplishments, a King transforms into a God. Worshipped by some tribes as a war god, a squad with the protection of a God is said to be undefeatable in combat. Its tactics are focused entirely on offense, free of waste, beautiful. Hero souls that receive the life-and-death power of a God stand at the zenith of combat prowess.

name: Defmon
description: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Though Spirits traditionally excel in magic and healing abilities, battles against other races naturally led to the rise of Spirit defense specialists, with the Defmons being toughest of all. They can withstand strikes from the hardiest of foes, routing the advance of countless assaults. A hero soul that attains their sturdy durability will come even closer to mastering the art of defense.

name: King Defmon
description: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A Defmon that accumulates significant experience earns the title of King. They offer impregnable defense to any unit they lead, keeping enemies at bay no matter how powerful they may be. This puts them odds with their offensively-focused Kilmon brethren, however. A hero soul that acquires a King's power will become that much more an expert in the art of defense.

name: Defmon God
description: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A King who protects its allies ascends to Godhood. Because of a God's ability to win battles without harm coming to any of its allies, earning it praise from even non-combatants. Seafarers worship Defmon Gods as protectors of the sea lanes. A hero soul that acquires the indomitable power of a God will be that much closer to attaining the pinnacle of defense.

name: Tufmon
description: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Tufmons are endurance personified, and are said to walk for three days straight without stopping as part of their training. The endurance they attain allows them to provide support and fight without so much as breaking a sweat. A hero soul that attains their power will become that much more persistent, that much more the spirit of endurance itself.

name: King Tufmon
description: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A Tufmon whose toughness has been recognized receives the title of King, and assumes this form. They frequently serve as arbitrators when Kilmons and Defmons butt heads, often ending up worse for wear in the process. Because only Tufmons can fulfill this role, however, they're essential to the squad. A hero soul that attains a King's power reaches a greater understanding of endurance.

name: Tufmon God
description: A Tufmon that accumulates years of experience transforms into a God. During a castle siege, when Kilmons and Defmons argued for their respective philosophies, Tufmon suggested persuading the ramparts to their cause. The ploy worked, and the castle opened its gates without violence, and the Kilmons and Defmons had to acknowledge they'd been outdone. A hero soul that attains the power of a God may just become endurance personified.
